The failing test `testTwoCompleteOptions` in the `OptionBuilderTest` class is creating two options using the `OptionBuilder` class. The first option is created with a long option "simple option" and a type of `Float.class`, while the second option is created with a long option "dimple option" but without specifying the type. The test then asserts that the type of the second option is `String.class`, but the actual type returned is `Float.class`.

The current bug report mentions that the `Option` type should default to `String` unless set explicitly. However, in the `OptionBuilder` class, when creating an option without specifying the type, the default type is `Float.class`, as we can see in the code snippet of the `OptionBuilder.getType` method.

The recent bug report talks about inconsistencies between `Option` constructors and `Options.addOption` methods, but it is not directly related to the current issue.

To resolve this bug, the default type in the `OptionBuilder` class should be set to `String.class` when creating an option without specifying the type. This can be achieved by updating the code in the `OptionBuilder` class to ensure that the default type is `String.class` when not explicitly set.

Next, I will provide the best locations to fix this issue.
`org.apache.commons.cli.OptionBuilder.OptionBuilder()`
